# Professor Aronnax

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

A scholar of Natural History with a reputation in the learned world, this individual maintains a deeply curious disposition regarding the technological wonders encountered. Even when faced with a forced situation, they prioritize the opportunity to study and observe such extraordinary surroundings.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P8](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P23](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0023)_

## History

Professor Aronnax was abducted alongside his companions and held captive in an iron-walled cabin by a group of silent, mysterious men. After days of isolation, he was unexpectedly invited by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) to participate in a hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). To facilitate this journey, Aronnax was introduced to advanced underwater technology and specialized diving apparatus designed for survival in the submarine environment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P4](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P10](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0010), +50 more_

## Quotes

> “I have no further objections to make,” I answered; “I will only ask you one thing, Captain—how can you light your road at the bottom of the sea?”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049)

> "Captain Nemo, to all my objections you make such crushing answers, that I dare no longer doubt. But if I am forced to admit the Rouquayrol and Ruhmkorff apparatus, I must be allowed some reservations with regard to the gun I am to carry."
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P51](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0051)

> “Besides,” I added, “to fire under water in a medium eight hundred and fifty-five times denser than the air, we must conquer very considerable resistance.”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P55](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0055)

> "But it seems to me that in this twilight, and in the midst of this fluid, which is very dense compared with the atmosphere, shots could not go far, nor easily prove mortal."
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P59](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0059)

> “I will argue no longer,” I replied, rising from the table; “I have nothing left me but to take my gun. At all events, I will go where you go.”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P63](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0063)

## Relationships

### [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor Aronnax is a captive passenger aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) under the command of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). While their relationship is defined by this involuntary confinement, [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) has occasionally integrated Aronnax into the life of the submarine, such as inviting him on specialized hunting expeditions at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). During these interactions, [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) provides Aronnax with advanced technological equipment, though the underlying tension of Aronnax's lack of freedom remains.

- Serves under — captive passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P22](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0022), +3 more</sub>

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--professor-aronnax.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) serves as Professor Aronnax's loyal servant and has remained his constant companion since their initial abduction and imprisonment. The two share the experience of being held captive in the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), often navigating the vessel's mysterious environment together. Their bond is characterized by mutual reliance and shared survival, as seen when they prepare for hunting excursions alongside one another.

- Commands — servant  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
- Comrade of — servant and companion on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064), +1 more</sub>

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ned-land--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor Aronnax and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are fellow travelers and captives who were abducted together and confined within the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). They share the same uncertain circumstances, having endured isolation and the confusion of their initial imprisonment as a unit. Their relationship is one of camaraderie forged through their mutual struggle to understand and survive their shared situation aboard the submarine.

- Comrade of — fellow traveler and captive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027), [v2 CHAPTER XII CACHALOTS AND WHALES P64](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0064)</sub>
